message.content:
This editorial illustration features a dark blue background with various visual elements. At the top, the white word "TEMPO" is printed in a large, serif font. Smaller text at the top includes "Kejar Tayang Revisi KUHP H.26," "Beking Mafia Tambang Kalimantan Timur H.58," "21-27 NOVEMBER 2022," and "RP 50.000." A barcode and QR code are in the upper right.

Centrally, two large, tan-colored human hands are shown in a gripping pose. Between them is a spherical object that resembles a globe, partially covered in a textured red layer. This red layer is being peeled back or torn away by the hands, revealing a light blue and green map underneath. Tucked into the gap where the red layer is torn are two green US dollar bills. The peeled portion of the red layer extends downward in a long, wavy ribbon.

At the bottom, white text reads: "OUTLOOK EKONOMI 2023," "Kilau Pembiayaan Hijau," and a smaller paragraph beginning with "Indonesia berpeluang mendapatkan pembiayaan..." and ending with "H.72."
